subject: Test and validate ZFS update
description:
Phase 6 of ZFS update: Comprehensive testing and validation.

Testing categories:
1. Functional tests:
   - Mount compatibility
   - Pool creation
   - Read/write operations
   - Snapshots and clones
2. Performance benchmarks:
   - I/O throughput comparison (old vs new)
   - ARC hit ratio and memory usage
   - Boot time impact
3. Stability tests:
   - 24+ hour continuous I/O workload
   - Crash recovery simulation
   - Power-loss simulation

Create test suite:
- tests/zfs/test-mount.cc
- tests/zfs/test-io.cc
- tests/zfs/test-snapshot.cc
- tests/zfs/test-perf.py

Prerequisites:
- All previous ZFS tasks complete

Timeline: 2-3 weeks
